prompt: Which statements about milestones are true? Choose all that apply.
explanation: Milestones are dated containers for issues and pull requests, charting completion as work closes. Closing one closes nothing and deletes nothing — and labels still classify within it.

options.text: A milestone has a target due date
Issues and pull requests can both belong to a milestone
A milestone page tracks completion progress
Closing a milestone deletes its issues
Milestones replace the need for labels
